full_judgment: 6. Defendant Nos. 5 and 6 in the written statement after taking preliminary objections as to maintainability of the suit, denied the plaint case line by line. It is their specific case that suit land originally belonged to Ananda Charan Datta and Gyananda Charan Datta and Nilmani Datta. 45.96 acres of land was recorded as projabili in the RS khatian. The entire land of jote for arrear of rent was put into auction and government purchased the suit land on 18-3-1934 and for managing the auction purchased land for which defendants' instituted further suit. The said lands purchased after auction still remain in previous Jote No.140. After 14 jote created by resettlement of the suit land in Miscellaneous Case No.651 of 1945-46 the suit land was resettled. After resettlement, Brojalal Chose, Sumon Lal Chose got 15.48 acres of land from several R.S. dag numbers involved in the suit and Jote No.180 was created which was recorded in R.S. No. 836/16. Brojalal Chose sold his land of Jote Nos.180. 181. 182 to Nasir Uddin, Khadija Begurn and Harun Matin and also to other persons and thereby became title less. The aforesaid purchasers in Mutation Case No.47/52-53 and JM Case No. 114/54-55 recorded their names in Jotekhatian No.835/16 and according to their possession, the suit land has been recorded in SA khatian Nos.74 and 94. The aforesaid purchase is, Nasiruddin, Khadija Begum and Harun Matin were non-Bengali and left the country for Pakistan during war of liberation and never came back and Government as per PO No. 16 of 1972 declared the property as enemy property. The said property during BS survey was recorded in the name of Government of Bangladesh. To protect the said property from illegal trespassers or illegal strangers in 1975 Government appointed Md Nurul Huda (defendant No.3) as care taker. Government through Miscellaneous Cases Nos.6 of 1980-81, 7 of 1980-81, 8 of 1980-81, 9 of 1980-81, 2 of 1981 -82 leased out the property in favour of Md Solaiman, Faruq Ahmed and others. Brojalal Ghosh was never tenant either under Ananda Charan or Gyananda Charan and was never resettlement holder of Government. Brojalal Ghose, Benulal Ghose and their heirs, who were owners of jote No. 180, 181, 182 through Resettlement Case No. 651/45-46, sold the suit land to Nash Uddin, Khodeja Begum, Harun Malin and others by several kabalas. The case of the plaintiffs of mutation of their names in Mutation Case No. 384/78-79, 480/78-79 is totally false and no such khatian was opened in the office of Assistant Commissioner, Land and Mutation Case No. 401/78-79 was not related to the suit property; that mutation case was related to Nurul Alam, son of Ashraf Ali, of village: Bakalia, Chittagong in respect of 0.28 decimals of land and Mutation Case No.430/78-79 was in respect of Pear Mohammad of Sakir-51, Keranigonj, Police Station Kotwali, Chittagong for 0.57 decimals of land. The aforesaid mutation case and khatian of the plaintiffs are false and prepared for ulterior motive. Plaintiffs and husband of plaintiff, Abul Bashar are members of gang of forged deed and they created several forged deeds and after creating different forged deeds they wanted to grab the property illegally. Criminal cases have been instituted against Abul Bashar, husband of plaintiff and also against Md Abdul Jalil and others. Double Mouring Police Station Case No. 32(1)87 under section 467/468/109 of the Penal Code was initiated on 30-1-1987. Charge-sheet was submitted and charge was framed and the case is pending in Criminal Motion No. 381 of 1989 which is pending before the Additional District Judge, 1st court, Chittagong. On these grounds defendants prayed for dismissal of the suit.
